# Inter

Unmodified variable WOFF2 from the official Inter repository:
https://github.com/rsms/inter/blob/master/docs/font-files/InterVariable.woff2

Downloaded 2026-09-23. Copyright Rasmus Andersson. SIL Open Font License 1.1,
included in LICENSE.txt. The build embeds this font in the standalone HTML,
